title: AI Chatbot That Finds Matching Providers and Replies With Their Details
summary: A chatbot for a dairy company that finds the right providers for each message, gathers their details automatically and replies with a ready answer.
headline: A chatbot that researches before it replies
seoTitle: AI Chatbot with Apify Provider Research
problem: Every customer message needed someone to work out which providers were relevant and collect their details before replying.
solution: When the chatbot receives a message, an Apify actor discovers the providers that fit it, a second actor extracts their relevant information, and the results are stored in a new Google Sheet. A reply to the original message is then generated from that data.
highlights: Triggered by each incoming chat message
Providers discovered automatically with an Apify actor
Details extracted with a second actor
Results saved to a fresh Google Sheet
Reply written from the collected data
role: Sole engineer. I designed and built the whole workflow.

results.label: Each message answered with researched, relevant provider details
No manual searching or copying of provider information
